findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but the only method defined in its superclass UsernamePasswordForm requires a UserModel argument. There is no zero-argument overload in the supplied inheritance hierarchy, so the services module fails compilation. Pass context.getUser() or provide the intended overload.

findings.title: New passkey predicate disables passkeys on ordinary login
findings.body: The new predicate requires user != null, and both authenticate() and the error challenge use it to decide whether to initialize conditional WebAuthn. On an ordinary login, context.getUser() is null because no identity has been selected yet, so the form no longer receives the conditional-UI attributes or WebAuthn challenge. This breaks the existing username-less discoverable-passkey login and removes the passkey option from initial username/password and username forms. The predicate must also allow the unidentified-user case rather than enabling passkeys exclusively after a user is selected.
